subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, com autonomia, cartas pessoais de reclamação, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, de acordo com as convenções do gênero carta e com a estrutura própria desses textos (problema, opinião, argumentos), considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar componentes estruturais de carta de reclamação: problema, opinião e argumentos
components.description_en: Identify the structural components of a complaint letter: problem, opinion, and supporting arguments
components.cc_component_description: Show relationships between claims, counterclaims, and supporting evidence and reasoning

components.description_pt: Aplicar convenções do gênero carta ao planejar uma carta de reclamação pessoal
components.description_en: Apply letter genre conventions when planning a personal complaint letter
components.cc_component_description: Apply a planning strategy appropriate to a specific purpose and audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Construir argumentos de apoio apropriados à reclamação sendo abordada
components.description_en: Construct supporting arguments appropriate to the complaint being addressed
components.cc_component_description: Develop a claim with relevant supporting evidence appropriate to the audience's knowledge level

components.description_pt: Produzir uma carta de reclamação escrita independentemente adaptada à situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Produce an independently written complaint letter adapted to its communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Organize informational or argumentative writing in a structure suited to its purpose

cc_matches.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.

Multilingual learners will construct social studies arguments that
* Introduce __and contextualize__ topic
* Select relevant information to support claims with evidence gathered from multiple sources
* Establish perspective
* Show relationships between claims __and counterclaims, differences in perspectives,__ and evidence __and reasoning__

Develop claim(s) and counterclaims fairly, supplying evidence for each while pointing out the strengths and limitations of both in a manner that anticipates the audience's knowledge level and concerns.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
